I worked as a developer for the Colgate Data Science Collaboratory from the fall of 2024 to the summer of 2025 under Dr. William Cipolli. I developed statistical apps for the DSC website, particularly: Two-Way ANOVA, Resampling, and Mixed Effects Regression.
